### 2026-10-27: My Schematic is finished. I'm going to work on the routing tomorrow. I don't have the footprint for the specific Xiao symbol apparently, but it's fine. At the very least, I have all the needed GPIO Pi

**1.28h**

My Schematic is finished. I'm going to work on the routing tomorrow. I don't have the footprint for the specific Xiao symbol apparently, but it's fine. At the very least, I have all the needed GPIO Pins. The lipo battery is going to be soldered into the battery  pins on the microcontroller, which means I don't have to budget for a usb charging module (yay).
![Screenshot 2026-10-27 at 9.48.45 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/o50ahq5LZfgfVNXxQFq0VHymdocnCotx/124a4dde86eed62ce66a404191f76b860ee89d7896e82af5c820c32e0433ccf5.png)

I think I have the display wired right. The TFT guide was hard to follow when it came to connecting pins to the header.
